4823-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4823-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
4823-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Timeless Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2577-4826-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-4826-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1303-1769-3899.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

586-3375-4247-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

13-3629-8089.easyPrerequisites:
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
Your life total is even.
13-3629-8089.description:
Activate Selenia by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1308-3129-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2137-6628-7857.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery
2137-6628-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce mana.
2137-6628-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand for which legal target(s) exist, if applicable.
2137-6628-7857.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control from the battlefield to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery spell.
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping PuPu UFO
Repeat steps 3 and 4 one additional time.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

5641-6012-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
5641-6012-7804.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

643-6264-7767.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to discard a card.
643-6264-7767.description:
Discard a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters as a Villain due to Maskwood Nexus, Prowler triggers, causing it to connive.
Repeat from step 2.
643-6264-7767.notes: You will need to break the combo, or you will eventually lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7706.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing White Widow.
When White Widow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When White Widow enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and up to one other creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3276-5038-5147-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat as needed.

1651-4231-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

813-957-7431.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

661-3685-4659-5901.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Artist's Talent. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-222-527-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2829-4559-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
2829-4559-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2829-4559-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4460-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

250-779-1479-2692-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2692-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

339-677-5295-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

560-2457-5794-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Soldier and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1636-4050-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-4050-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

1245-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures
1245-6753.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-6618-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Relm's Sketching
2743-6618-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Relm's Sketching twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Relm's Sketchings, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1339-2034-2122-6260.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-6260.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2532-4939-5200.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2034-2532-4939-5200.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Burning-Tree Emissary token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Burning-Tree Emissary token dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat.

2196-2404-2821-5803.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2196-2404-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three creatures.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
2196-2404-2821-5803.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and another land by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Gaea's Cradle and another land.
Activate Gaea's Cradle and another land by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

440-1339-2034-5796.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-5796.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Starving Revenant trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Starving Revenant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

440-1339-2034-4716.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-4716.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-5445-5686.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
3197-5445-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
3197-5445-5686.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Beast.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 3.

1770-3448-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Stadium Vendors.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding four mana of any color.
Repeat.

837-2440-3263-5181.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves and/or Shamans.
837-2440-3263-5181.description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Golgari Findbroker to your hand.
Cast Golgari Findbroker by paying {4}.
When Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Findbroker trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {5}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Elves and/or Shamans, this combo nets infinite mana.

1940-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Blood Pet dies, triggering Liliana and Mortuary.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Blood Pet.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1605-3059-5253.notablePrerequisites: Brion does not have summoning sickness.
1605-3059-5253.description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Malignus, dealing damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

864-3742-4872.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
864-3742-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness that is tapped and attacking.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
